title: Adversarial Ambiguity
reward: Learn that sophisticated behavior may imitate normality and normality may look hostile.
knowledge: Low-and-slow behavior can evade simple rate thresholds.
Bots can imitate browser cadence, paths and user agents; surface resemblance is weak evidence.
Legitimate automation can resemble scanning or credential abuse.
Prefer combinations of independent hard-to-fake features over one cosmetic signal.
When alternatives remain plausible, abstention is a successful decision.
challenge: Analyze an ambiguous case with two competing hypotheses.
Choose abstention when discriminating evidence is absent.
next_requires: Resist both attacker mimicry and false-positive temptation.
